source.notes: Generated by scripts/run_openai_bench.py; accepted community submission from @mvdevnull via GitHub issue #5

hardware.pcie: GPU0 x8 gen3, GPU1 x8 gen3, GPU2 x4 gen3 (all PHB via CPU host bridge, no NVLink)
hardware.notes: ASUS PRIME Z390-A, Intel i7-8700 (6c/12t), 61GB DDR4 RAM. Confirmed via nvidia-smi and 'ollama ps' PROCESSOR field that the model is 100 percent GPU-resident across all 3 cards throughout.

runtime.notes: Ollama 0.32.14 (bundled llama.cpp backend, CUDA 13 libs). Underlying llama-server launch flags: -np 1 --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 --flash-attn on -b 512 -ub 512 --spec-type draft-mtp --spec-draft-n-max 4 --spec-draft-backend-sampling --context-shift --keep 4

model.source: Ollama tag built FROM the stock qwen3.8:27b-mtp-q8_0 GGUF weights (same blob), with PARAMETER num_ctx explicitly pinned to 204800 in its own Modelfile (derived from a sibling tag that pins 246952). Confirmed via 'ollama ps' to be 100 percent GPU-resident at this size.
model.notes: Local Ollama tag layers a project-specific SYSTEM prompt over the stock model for an unrelated use case; underlying weights/quant/architecture are unmodified stock Qwen3.8 27B Q8_0.

serving.tensor_parallel: n/a (llama.cpp layer split via Ollama automatic GPU placement, not explicitly configured)

caveats: Runtime is Ollama (llama.cpp backend), not raw llama.cpp CLI or vLLM; launch flags captured from the live process, not manually authored.

A sibling tag with the same weights but num_ctx 246952 required approximately 6 percent CPU offload on this 3x-5060Ti (48GB) budget; 204800 was chosen specifically because it is the largest round tier confirmed at 100 percent GPU residency via 'ollama ps'.
Sustained long-output generation at full context was not separately measured in this pass; long-retrieval used a 96-token target answer, not a long generation.
split-mode/tensor placement is Ollama's automatic default, not explicitly pinned by the operator.
